name: Recall ten associated items
short_description: Learn and recall ten paired items after a 24-hour delay using a chosen memory strategy.
self_assessment: I can recall ten paired items after 24 hours without help or reference notes.
description: Learn and recall ten paired items after a 24-hour delay using a chosen memory strategy. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
